title: Large underground facility beneath the Pentagon processing USAP read-ons

tellings.quote: >> And then I under Washington DC, the Pentagon, I I have reason to believe there's a very large underground facility,

plain: There is a very large underground facility beneath the Pentagon, the story goes, where people are "read on", that is, formally briefed into USAPs, unacknowledged special access programmes whose very existence the government does not admit. The researcher who posts online as UAPGerb tells Michels he has "reason to believe" this, without saying what that reason is. If true, it would mean the most secret programmes have their own hidden machinery under Washington.
